Cockroach Effigy to Burn Alongside Ravan at Delhi Ramlila Amid Protests

A 30-foot effigy of a cockroach is set to be burned alongside the effigy of Ravan at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan. This is occurring amidst protests by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP).
